title: Too shallow, no room for fillings.
text: Too shallow, no room for fillings.. The space allowed for fillings is very shallow. I made some pizza type sandwiches and it literally only fit 2 pepperonis. Lol! Just 2 per sandwich. Also it doesn’t cut the sandwich in 2 pieces like it’s supposed to. You end up with 1 sandwich with an indention in the middle. I had something similar years ago and that one made them the thickness of Hot Pockets. This one can only make very small flat sandwiches. Seriously, it wouldn’t close with more than TWO little slices of pepperoni in it.
